heading: Sunday Night
text: Clearing, with some high cloud returning to the north late. Not as muggy. Lows in the upper 50s and 60s. Winds northwest less than 10 mph, becoming light and variable.

heading: Monday
text: Morning sun mixed with high clouds. More afternoon clouds with a rising chance of scattered afternoon showers or a thunderstorm over New York and southern Ontario, spreading over the Green Mountains in the evening. Rain heaviest north of Route 4 after dark. Less humid. Highs in the upper 70s and 80s. Winds light, mainly south less than 10 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Scattered showers or thunderstorms becoming likely north, with a rising chance south. Rain tapering off around midnight, after in the southeast. Lows in the low to mid 60s.
